name: Plaitseal
description: Let both thongs hang from the hands in ordered loops so that each stands guard for the other.

name: Lash Crown
description: Throw the lead thong at the foe's face to open the exchange and draw the guard up.

name: Snapgrace
description: Step over the line of the foe's lead foot with both thongs swinging in even time.

name: Sigilkeeper
description: Throw both thongs in a crossing pair of loops so the foe's wrist is caught between them.

name: Royal Lashcore
description: Crack the right thong and let the left crack follow as an echo that unsettles the foe's timing.

name: Undefiled Whipstock
description: Hold the two thongs in a fork and let a thrusting point slip into the notch and out.

name: Bedrock Fall
description: Draw both thongs along the same line of the foe's coat so that the second widens the cut of the first.

name: Furlverdict
description: Open with the left thong then enter on the right so that the body arrives as the second stroke lands.

name: Millstone Tether
description: Pin both of the foe's arms with twin thongs of qi so that neither blade can rise.

name: Tenettether
description: The school signature stroke binds the foe with one thong and ends the exchange with the other at a pitch the student reserve sets.

name: Steady Popper
description: Stand with a thong in each hand and the forearms crossed low in front of the belt.

name: Vigor Whipheel
description: Throw the right thong in a clear high arc that begins the azure forms.

name: Bedrock Popcrack
description: Take a sliding step along the foe's line while the left thong snaps behind the right.

name: Thrall Whiptail
description: Wrap a foe's sword hand with the left thong and hold it while the right hand stays free.

name: Volition Keeper
description: Crack the left thong against an advancing foe so the right can set up unhurried.

name: Keeperseal
description: Turn the right thong over the wrist and knock down a cut aimed at the head.

name: Peal Lashend
description: Hook the foe's rear ankle with one thong and pull as the other thong strikes the chest.

name: Snap Crown
description: Cut with both thongs from opposite sides so their qi crosses on the foe's torso.

name: Harmonious Furl
description: Pass the stroke from one hand to the other mid-cast so the angle of attack changes without a pause.

name: Storied Flick
description: Throw both thongs after a long breath of gathered qi to strike every foe at the front.

name: Haemal Thong
description: The school's signature draws both thongs into a single lash whose force follows the reserve the student chooses to give it.

name: Thongtroth
description: Hold the lash coiled at the shoulder in the quiet stance of a hawk surveying the court.

name: Reminiscence Lashend
description: Sweep the gaze from one foe to the next and note how each carries the weight.

name: Furlbanner
description: Lower the shoulder and throw the lash downward in a short sharp dive at the nearest foe.

name: Delugeplait
description: Take two light beats on the toes and land at an angle to the foe's guard.

name: Thongpledge
description: Close the loop around a foe's arm with a talon grip of qi and pull it taut.

name: Squall Whiptail
description: Lift the thong in a rising sweep that beats a descending blade outward.

name: Fearless Whipstock
description: Crack sharply over the heads of a group so that the nervous among them break ranks.

name: Quenched Snap
description: Hold the tip still in the air for a breath then sting the exposed wrist.

name: Radiance Popcrack
description: Dive from the raised stance with qi fixed at the tip so it pierces a gap in plate.

name: Gallant Plait
description: Wheel the thong overhead in widening circles then let it fall across the whole line of foes.

name: Lashtroth
description: Gather qi in the raised loop and drop it over a foe who is then lifted off balance.

name: Grand Volition Furl
description: The school's signature sequence watches then dives then seizes the foe in one stroke whose reach follows the student's reserve.

name: Immaculate Fall
description: Stand with the cracker loaded and the thong looped over the forearm like a river held in its bed.

name: Heroic Keeper
description: Crack the whip at the foe's side so the sound runs past them like water past a bank.

name: Squall Flick
description: Hop lightly along an imaginary gravel bar and keep the thong swinging at the back leg.

name: Inferno Whipheel
description: Cut in time with the echo of the crack so that the sting seems to come from the sound.

name: Plait Reliquary
description: Wind the thong round the foe's torso in a smooth current and pull the arms to the sides.

name: Popper Vow
description: Flick the thong in rapid short strokes that scatter an incoming blow like spray.

name: Millstone Lashcore
description: Crack the whip in a rolling chain that echoes down the valley and pins every foe in earshot.

name: Volition Lash
description: Open with a thunderous crack and cut along the sound before the foe has recovered.

name: Thunderclap Keeper
description: Pour a swollen surge of qi into the cracker so a single cut parts a shield rim.

name: Furledict
description: The school's signature crack rolls out over the field with a force and a reach that the student's reserve sets.

name: Sainted Lashend
description: Begin low and quiet with the thong barely moving like a spring just breaking the ground.

name: Famed Whipheel
description: Throw a thin small lash that trickles forward and tests the foe's guard.

name: Skyborne Popper
description: Descend in zigzag steps as a stream descends a slope and gather speed as the line straightens.

name: Tetherseal
description: Cast a loop that joins the foe's arm like a tributary joining the main stream and tighten it.

name: Steel Popcrack
description: Cut in fast broken strokes like water in rapids so the foe cannot find a rhythm to meet.

name: Thongseal
description: Throw the thong across a blow like a weir across a stream and let the force spill off to one side.

name: Royal Fall
description: Split a single stroke into three narrow lashes that spread like channels of a delta.

name: Bedrock Lash
description: Pour qi along the whole length of the thong in a steady flow that gains strength toward its mouth.

name: Volition Plait
description: Draw the foes into the thong's slow circuit like water running to a basin and hold them there.

name: Peerless Tether
description: Release a wide overflow of qi from a held cast that spreads over the foes in front like a flood.

name: Orchestral Whiptail Edict
description: The school's signature carries one stroke from a trickle to a flood and spends as much of the reserve as the student allows.

name: Popperpledge
description: Stand upright with both lashes turning in slow matched rings above the shoulders.

name: Illustrious Lashcore
description: Time the throw to the pulse of the Core so that the lash lands on the beat.

name: Deluge Thong
description: Move in long even bounds with both lashes trailing at equal distance.

name: Interstice Thong
description: Feel the pulse of qi in both lashes and judge how much each can still give.

name: Millstone Snap
description: Throw both lashes high so they descend in a pair of loops over the foe's head and arms.

name: Undaunted Popper
description: Spin the two lashes in interlocking rings that carry a heavy blow around the body.

name: Peerless Furl
description: Cut with both lashes together on a line that cannot be parried with a single motion.

name: Magnificent Tether
description: Crack both lashes overhead so the double report numbs the ears of nearby foes.

name: Thunderclap Whipstock
description: Drive Core-born qi through both lashes at once so the combined point passes through a shield.

name: Ironclad Lashcore
description: Send the lashes orbiting the body in opposite directions so that no angle is left open.

name: Fearless Flick
description: Raise both lashes with a long breath and bring them down in one matched fall of qi.

name: Harmonious Lashend Crown
description: The school's highest signature moves both lashes as a single will whose reach and weight follow the reserve of the Core.

name: Venerable Plait
description: Stand on level ground with the thong lowered and the open hand raised in pledge.

name: Vigorplait
description: Throw the first stroke in the open as the oath requires and hide nothing of its line.

name: Silken Lash
description: Move forward across level ground at a steady pace with the thong trailing in the wind.

name: Tethering Whipstock
description: Wrap the foe's arm with a promise to hold without harm until they yield.

name: Statute Snap
description: Crack the thong with a clear carrying report like a voice raised in the open.

name: Pealfall
description: Receive the blow on the thong held steady like a word that will not be broken.

name: Sovereign Furl
description: Cut only after the wind has been tested by a first trial flick of the tip.

name: Steel Whipheel
description: Throw the full thong with qi behind it so that the stroke carries as far as a pledge.

name: Tenetflick
description: Chain a wrap then a pull then a cut in a fixed order so each part is declared by stance.

name: Storied Tether
description: Raise the thong overhead with qi gathered in a long hold and let the stroke fall at the foe.

name: Quenched Keeper
description: The school's signature is a sworn stroke whose weight and reach match whatever reserve the student pledges to it.

name: Plaitpledge
description: Stand with the thong lifted a little by the air and ready to follow it.

name: Thunderclap Thong
description: Start the stroke on the first rise of a gust and let it add speed to the throw.

name: Ethereal Fall
description: Slip around to the sheltered side of the foe so that the wind blows only upon them.

name: Cording Popcrack
description: Cast a loop on a gust that swells in the air and falls over the foe's shoulders.

name: Volition Whiptail
description: Crack the thong into the wind so the report is carried back on the foe's own side.

name: Peal Lashcore
description: Raise the thong so that a gust lifts it across an arriving cut.

name: Inferno Keeper
description: Cut across the wind so that it bends the stroke into the foe's unguarded flank.

name: Tether Verdict
description: Spin the thong in a wheel that catches the wind and lashes all near the turning.

name: Noble Flick
description: Gather the wind and qi into a single point at the tip and drive it through armor.

name: Matchless Whipstock Verdict
description: The school's signature calls the wind into the stroke and strikes with whatever force the student's reserve gives it.

name: Hospitable Thong
description: Sight along the thong at the foe and take the bearing that will be held through the exchange.

name: Flicktriumph
description: Throw the lash along the held bearing so that the line of the stroke is plain and true.

name: Lithe Fall
description: Step so the body keeps the same angle to the foe whichever way they turn.

name: Sainted Popper
description: Brace the whip arm along the bearing so that no blow can turn the stance.

name: Cinching Lash
description: Wrap the foe's arm along the held bearing and keep the line taut as they twist.

name: Bedrock Whipheel
description: Crack along the bearing so that the sound drives the foe off the line of approach.

name: Parity Lashend
description: Turn aside a blow while keeping the thong aligned on the original bearing.

name: Snappledge
description: Hook the foe's ankle along the heading and drag so their step breaks.

name: Squallfurl
description: Hold qi steady as the gale shifts and release a long cast that keeps its original line.

name: Volition Popcrack
description: Chain four strokes on one bearing so that each prepares the foe to be struck by the next.

name: Steel Snap
description: Drive a stroke on the held bearing with enough qi that no guard turns it from its line.

name: Imperial Thunderclap Whiptail
description: The school's signature cast follows the bearing taken at the start of the exchange with the weight the student allows.

name: Steelpopper
description: Stand wide with the cracker drawn back and the whole body ready to throw it forward.

name: Statute Plait
description: Crack the thong at the peak of a gust so the report is carried further than its own strength.

name: Vigorsnap
description: Press forward against the wind in short braced steps with the thong close to the body.

name: Thunderclap Tether
description: Pair a crack beside the ear with a sting to the wrist before the foe can turn.

name: Thongvow
description: Cast a loop over the foe as the crack sounds and tighten it on the report.

name: Pall Lashcore
description: Crack the thong against a blade so that the shock of the report knocks it aside.

name: Statute Flick
description: Send a rolling series of small cracks across the ground that keep the foe from advancing.

name: Pulsar Furl
description: Drive the crack through a headwind with qi at the tip so that it still cuts at its end.

name: Millstone Lash
description: Chain long cracks across the plateau so the foes in earshot slow and hold their ground.

name: Entropy Lashend
description: Gather the gale behind one crack that breaks over the line of foes and shakes their stance.

name: Statute Whipheel
description: The school's signature is the single great crack whose range and weight rise with the reserve the student spends.

name: Prism Popper
description: Stand with the long lash coiled at the hip and the oath held in the breath.

name: Thunderclap Plait
description: Throw the long thong full out in a cast that is committed from its first motion.

name: Plaitvoyage
description: Pace the long stroke across level ground in strides that never shorten.

name: Thrall Snap
description: Throw a long loop that settles over a distant foe and holds with the weight of a vow.

name: Illustrious Whipstock
description: Crack the long thong at the far edge of the field so that the report warns the nearest foe.

name: Enshrined Keeper
description: Draw the long thong back across the front and knock a blade from its line.

name: Intrepid Furl
description: Throw the long thong over a low rise by qi alone and bring it down upon an unseen foe.

name: Ruling Thong
description: Hold a line of qi across the field with the long thong so that all must slow to cross it.

name: Intrepid Whiptail
description: Gather qi in the long thong through a still hold and let it fall upon the farthest foe.

name: Choral Season Lashcore
description: The school's signature carries wrap and pull and cut across the whole field at a scale set by the student's reserve.

name: Prismkeeper
description: Stand easy with the thong afloat in the air and the Core steady in the breath.

name: Vigorfurl
description: Throw the lash on the final rise of the gust so the wind bears it all the way home.

name: Delugetether
description: Drift sideways on the wind with feet barely touching so the foe loses the line of the body.

name: Serene Fall
description: Read the wind in the thong and the Core in the breath until the two agree.

name: Thrallfall
description: Let the wind carry the open loop onto the foe and tighten it with a Core pulse.

name: Fallpledge
description: Veer the thong with the wind so that the blow slides away along its curve.

name: Lashtriumph
description: Send a crack that the wind spreads wide over the field and that strikes every ear alike.

name: Thunderclap Flick
description: Hook a foe's blade arm with the gust's help and pull it out of its line.

name: Pulsar Thong
description: Drive Core qi and the gale together into one thin point that pierces a barrier of plate.

name: Faithful Whiptail
description: Orbit the thong around the body on the wind so that arrows and thrown blades are carried away.

name: Squall Fall
description: Raise the thong into the wind with Core qi gathered and let the whole gust fall upon the foe.

name: Flickbanner
description: The school's final signature joins lash and wind in one sequence whose scale follows the reserve of the student's Core.
